ValidationRule.description: When the SwitcherDocumentstatus has been updated from Attached to Invalid and Invalid Switcher Reason AND Invalid Switcher Comment is blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( SC_Record_Type_Formula__c="Sales Support", ISPICKVAL(SC_SwitcherDocumentStatus__c, "Invalid"), OR( ISPICKVAL(SC_InvalidSwitcherReason__c, ""), ISBLANK(SC_InvalidSwitcherComments__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Both Invalid Switcher Reason and Comments are required when marking a switcher as invalid. Please complete both fields.
